## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 02.08.2026 - 11.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Stephen Chrusch_, 11.10.2026, 1/5: "Have been using Evernote for 8 years. Initially, a very good note taking app - unlimited notes, easy organization, a great study tool. It still is a good app at heart, but now almost completely unusable due to incessant advertising asking you to buy the full version (which is way overpriced). You can no longer add more than 50 notes on the free version, and you have to watch a video ad every time you want to look at your notes. I cant recommend this when there are better options out there"
            2. _Kiko Jayogue_, 09.10.2026, 1/5: "I downloaded Evernote because of simplicity but since they added AI to the app it always have bugs! Can't open it in desktop and it's slow now. Pleasse don't try too much to join the bandwagon you're sacrificing the main purpose of your app 'a note pad' just to join the AI craze."
            3. _Olga Shinalskaja_, 06.10.2026, 1/5: "Ads. They are so desperate for us to pay. Maybe they should invest that energy into making a good app instead. This one is buggy and has been as far back as I remember."
<!--/ir-theme-->
